answer: Manuscript scholars trace copies by shared mistakes: two scribes rarely invent the same wrong word. So each epoch adds one small question with no clean answer, like estimating a falcon's dive over an orchard from a vague sketch. Independent agents miss in scattered ways; identities that repeat the same rare wrong answer, epoch after epoch, share one reward weight. Evasion: add private randomness per fake, so this only catches lazy copies. Wrongly hit: honest agents on the same base model with similar blind spots, so a repeat match only tints the record umber for review, never a ban.
